review_text: Horrible experience. The system crashed during peak billing hours and our staff was locked out for 4 hours. No phone support available, only an unresponsive ticket queue. We lost over $4,000 in customer transactions. Avoid this platform!

The user interface looks sleek, but the pricing is completely deceptive. They charged us a hidden $150 onboarding fee that was never mentioned during the demo. When I asked for a refund, support said it was non-refundable in the fine print.

Revio has transformed our customer support turnaround. We consolidated Trustpilot and Google reviews into a single pipeline. The AI draft responses are shockingly accurate and sound natural. Saves our CX team 15+ hours weekly.
App crashes constantly on iOS 18.2 whenever I try to export reports to CSV. It used to be great, but the latest v3.4 update broke core functionality. Please fix ASAP or we are moving to BirdEye.

Great feature set and solid reliability. Data synchronization takes about 10-15 minutes which could be faster, but analytics dashboards give our executive board great visibility into Net Promoter Score.
Zero stars if I could. Fraudulent double-billing on our corporate credit card. Reached out three times with zero resolution. Our legal team is now initiating a credit card chargeback.
Outstanding customer service! Mohak from the onboarding team stayed on a Zoom call with our team for 45 minutes to troubleshoot custom API webhooks. Highly recommend Cynbit and Revio.
Love the clean minimalist UI and how easy it is to set up autonomous review auto-replies. Would love to see deeper integration with Slack and HubSpot in the next roadmap update.
Maintenance team never showed up to fix the water leakage in unit 402 despite 4 reminders in the tenant portal. Unacceptable living conditions and completely dismissive management.
Decent reputation monitoring capabilities, but sentiment classification frequently misinterprets sarcasm. Customer support is polite but response times over weekends are slow.
